# Security & Input Validation Checklist: Taskify Kanban Productivity Platform (Phase 1 MVP)

**Purpose**: Audit requirements quality, completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability for security, dual-layer Zod input validation, permission boundaries, and real-time concurrency/recovery prior to task generation and implementation.
**Created**: 2026-11-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md) | [rest-api.md](../contracts/rest-api.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are exact character length bounds, whitespace-trimming rules, and nullability constraints explicitly specified for every user-submitted field across projects, tasks, and comments? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-006, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK002 Are validation requirements defined for all request headers, path parameters, and query parameters in addition to JSON request bodies? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Contract §1]
- [x] CHK003 Are the required attributes and fixed identifiers for all five predefined users (1 Product Manager, 4 Engineers) and three sample projects completely specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003, Data Model §1]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for how missing or unrecognized `X-Active-User-Id` headers are handled on read (`GET`) versus write (`POST`/`PATCH`/`DELETE`) operations? [Completeness, Gap, Contract §1]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the standardized validation error structure clearly specified so that "clear, user-friendly error messages that reveal no internal system details" can be implemented without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Contract §1]
- [x] CHK006 Are the rules for comment ownership (`authorId` derivation and active-user comparison) unambiguously defined to prevent client-side spoofing of comment authorship? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Data Model §2.2]
- [x] CHK007 Is the single-assignee cardinality (`0..1`) and the distinction between an omitted `assigneeId` field versus an explicit `null` (unassign) clearly specified for partial task updates? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Contract §3]
- [x] CHK008 Are input sanitization rules for free-text fields (`Project.description`, `Task.description`, `Comment.content`) explicitly clarified regarding HTML/script tags versus plain-text storage and rendering? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Are comment permission requirements consistent between User Story 3, Functional Requirement `FR-009`, and the Assumptions section regarding author-only edit/delete versus project/task deletion scope? [Consistency, Spec §US-3, §FR-009, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK010 Do dual-layer Zod validation requirements align consistently between the API gateway edge and each downstream microservice boundary (`projects-service`, `tasks-service`, `notifications-service`)? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [x] CHK011 Are task status enum definitions (`To Do`, `In Progress`, `In Review`, `Done`) and unrestricted transition rules consistent across `spec.md`, `data-model.md`, and `contracts/rest-api.md`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-008]

## Acceptance Criteria & Measurability

- [x] CHK012 Can the requirement that "100% of invalid input submissions are rejected with clear validation messages before data is stored" be objectively measured against a complete enumeration of invalid input classes? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK013 Is the `< 1 second` real-time board update criterion (`SC-003`) clearly bounded as to whether it measures local optimistic UI latency, persistent storage confirmation, or cross-client SSE broadcast latency? [Measurability, Ambiguity, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK014 Are acceptance criteria defined for distinguishing between `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `400 INVALID_USER`, `401 UNAUTHORIZED_SERVICE`, and `403 FORBIDDEN_NOT_COMMENT_AUTHOR` across security boundaries? [Acceptance Criteria, Contract §1]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK015 Are boundary requirements specified for strings at exact character limits (`100` for project name, `150` for task title, `1000` for comment content, `2000` for task description) including multi-byte Unicode characters? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-004, §FR-006, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK016 Are requirements defined for what happens when a task card is moved into a column with existing tasks regarding `position` index calculation and potential position collisions? [Coverage, Gap, Data Model §2.1]
- [x] CHK017 Does the specification define expected behavior when a task creation or update references a `projectId` that does not exist in `projects-service`? [Edge Case, Coverage, Contract §3]

## Concurrency, Exception & Recovery Requirements

- [x] CHK018 Are conflict-resolution requirements specified when two active users simultaneously move the same task card to different Kanban columns or edit/delete the same comment across tabs? [Coverage, Concurrency, Gap]
- [x] CHK019 Are failure-handling and rollback requirements defined if a task or comment mutation succeeds in `tasks-service` but the asynchronous domain event dispatch to `notifications-service` fails? [Exception Flow, Recovery, Gap, Plan §Project Structure]
- [x] CHK020 Are client state recovery and missed-event reconciliation requirements specified when an active SSE stream (`/api/v1/events/stream`) disconnects and reconnects? [Recovery, Gap, Contract §4]

## Non-Functional & Security Governance Requirements

- [x] CHK021 Are Zero-Trust inter-service authentication requirements (`X-Internal-Service-Token` rotation, missing-token rejection, and gateway header stripping) completely specified to prevent external clients from forging internal headers? [Non-Functional, Security, Plan §Constitution Check, Contract §1]
- [x] CHK022 Are rate-limiting, payload-size limits, and SSE connection limits specified at the API gateway boundary to mitigate denial-of-service risks under the Security-First principle? [Non-Functional, Security, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK023 Is the assumption that idempotent database seeding (`5` predefined users and `3` sample projects) runs safely across repeated service restarts without duplicating or overwriting user-created data explicitly documented? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Data Model §1]
- [x] CHK024 Are cross-service startup order dependencies and health-check requirements specified between `api-gateway`, `projects-service`, `tasks-service`, and `notifications-service`? [Dependency, Gap, Plan §Project Structure]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
